raw: {"note": "Changing TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' would pull shard 10 into training, but EVAL_SHARD=10 is the fixed held-out evaluation data, so the model would train on its own evaluation set and val_bpb would stop measuring real generalization.", "verdict": "warn"}

parsed.note: Changing TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' would pull shard 10 into training, but EVAL_SHARD=10 is the fixed held-out evaluation data, so the model would train on its own evaluation set and val_bpb would stop measuring real generalization.
